ratios.quote: The Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio, under the 2026 Credit Agreement, at September 30, 2026, was negative 0.14.

In addition, the 2026 Credit Agreement contains financial covenants that require the Company to (i) maintain a Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio of no greater than 2.50 to 1.00, (ii) maintain a Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio of no less than 2.50 to 1.00, and (iii) maintain a minimum balance of domestic unrestricted cash and cash equivalents of $ 40.0 million.
